notes.title: Achievement update
notes.content:
Preface

Good day to you all. I've received a huge amount of feedback (game reviews, comments in discussions, and even personal messages) regarding the achievements.

I understand that the DMCA was extremely unpleasant news for you, as well as for me. So I've decided to release a big update directly related only to the achievements.

This news will be divided into 3 parts.

1) Briefly about all changes.
2) Detailed update information with examples.
3) Answers to questions you might have.

I hope you will like this update, as I spent a lot of time to make it. I am also waiting for your opinion about this update, it is really important to me. 

                                      Thank you for your attention and have a good game 

Short information about update 

 Added 6 types of letters from A-Z, numbers from 0-9 and symbols !, $,%,?.
 Added achievements consisting of 7 pictures
 Added achievements consisting of 14 pictures
 Added dog memes
 Added cat memes
 Added bird memes
 Changed achievements with flags 
 Changed name and description for all country flags
 Changed or removed achievements with dogs

 Changed or removed achievements with birds
 Changed name and description for all achievements with birds
 Changed or removed achievements with famous people

 Removed national emblems 
 Removed some types of letters and symbols

Yes, more and better than this one

Nope, If you have unlocked them before

 How can I get back my achievement ?

I need to know what do you have Instead of your old achievement now and I will return your old achievement to the new place

How many achievements were changed/added ?

notes.title: Community achievements R.I.P.
notes.content:
One of my game was removed because one of the achievement has dmca problems and i have had to removed it to bring game back.

Thats why I have to remove ALL dmca achievements and i dont know what can i say..... 

Im just a fool who gave you achievements and now take it away 

Little faq 

Q: My achievements was removed can get new one without DMCA ?

A; Yes of course

Q; Why should i trust you now and why you wont remove it again ?

A: If achievements dont have any DMCA problem I wont remove it

Q; My achievements didnt have DMCA problem but you have removed them can i get it back ?

A: Yes you can if you give any proof its your picture and you have right for it

Q: How long does it take to remove achievements ?

A: Hope i can do it in 2 weeks

Q; Only this game ?

A; No I have to remove all dmca achievement in all my games

Q: Why did you close thread with comunity achievements ?

A: Because I need time to remove all DMCA achievements and when i done I open it again

Q; Why you dont care about DMCA earlier?

A: Seriously I didnt know that achievements can be a problem and my game can be removed cause of them. 

Q; Are you a fool and you dont care about your customers ?

A: Yes Im a fool but I care about my customers  and really think I did something good when i  had added  achievements but I didnt think about DMCA and It was my bad 

Q: What is DMCA

A:Digital Millennium Copyright Act  That means I cant use copyright content without permission original author Even fun art is DMCA 

That is all If you have any question you can leave it here and sorry again....
